name: coverage-aggregate
//: The repo-level coverage gate: clears the shared profile directory before the crates' instrumented test runs, then merges their profiles and enforces the line floor over the gh-secrets crate's own sources (src/), once. It depends on exactly what can move that number — the crates whose tests write profiles (tag coverage:profiles) and the coverage driver — so a tooling or bench change does not rerun the product suites.
